name: synthetic_csr
description: Fictional CSR-like documents with hand-specified gold annotations.

cases.description: Single production-part CSR: simple, multiple, table, revision, distractor and section-like references; three internal conflicts.
Two provided documents: a logistics CSR and the packaging specification it references; exclusion, precedence, name aliases and cross-document conflicts.
ECU CSR with prefixed chapter labels (TSA 2.1), long requirements, similar identifiers, revision variants and spacing aliases.
Three provided documents (CSR, approval procedure, material specification) with nested references, mutual precedence, an exclusion contradicted downstream and cross-document conflicts.
Interior trim CSR with supersession, dense similar identifiers, distractor tokens, unavailable external documents and non-conflicting overlaps.
